claim: The phone's Today screen serves the house's money to owners and managers only (ADR 0253, Answered 2026-10-01 round 2, the founder: 'Close it to staff (Recommended)'). GET /mobile/feed builds order-approval cards only when seesHouseMoney(req.user.role) holds, takes `amount` off every card and leaves counts.orderApprovals out for anyone else; GET /mobile/today-pulse makes no Toast sales read and leaves revenueToday, checksToday, revenueLastWeek and deltaPct out for anyone else, and its decision counts are the caller's own feed. seesHouseMoney is roleSatisfies(role, 'manager') from procurement/order-approval-gate.ts, so null, an absent role, staff and any unknown string get the staff view. The role is req.user.role, the role in the token's house that JwtStrategy re-reads per request (ADR 0162); the controller hands it to both reads. Behaviour: mobile/mobile-feed-money-for-staff.spec.ts (22 cases, 18 red on origin/main 4bd11a00e; 4 source mutations killed). This verify pins the shape and fails on 4bd11a00e.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; G='apps/api-gateway/src/mobile/'; R=lambda p: re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*][\s\S]*?[*]/','',open(p).read())); sv=R(G+'mobile.service.ts'); ct=R(G+'mobile.controller.ts'); m=re.search(r'export function seesHouseMoney[(][^)]*[)][^{]*[{]([^}]*)[}]',sv); bad=[]; bad+=['seesHouseMoney is missing or is not roleSatisfies(role, manager)'] if (not m or m.group(1).strip()!='return roleSatisfies(role, \x22manager\x22);') else []; bad+=['the approve-card loop is not gated on money'] if 'for (const order of (money ? orders : [])' not in sv else []; bad+=['cards for a non-money role keep amount'] if not re.search(r'money\s*[?]\s*items\s*:\s*items[.]map[(][(][{] amount: _withheld, [.][.][.]card [}][)] => card[)]',sv) else []; bad+=['a sales read is not behind money'] if (len(re.findall(r'money\s*[?]\s*this[.]toastService\s*[.]getSalesData[(]',sv))!=2 or sv.count('getSalesData(')!=2) else []; bad+=['the pulse counts are not the caller own feed'] if 'this.getFeed(userId, restaurantId, role)' not in sv else []; bad+=['revenue is not spread only under money'] if not re.search(r'[.][.][.][(]money\s*[?]\s*[{]\s*revenueToday,',sv) else []; bad+=['the order-approval count is not spread only under money'] if not re.search(r'[.][.][.][(]money\s*[?]\s*[{]\s*orderApprovals:',sv) else []; bad+=['getFeed does not require a role'] if not re.search(r'async getFeed[(]\s*userId: string,\s*restaurantId: string,\s*role: string [|] null,?\s*[)]',sv) else []; bad+=['the controller does not hand req.user.role to both reads'] if ct.count('user.role ?? null,')!=2 else []; print(chr(10).join(bad) or 'ok'); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
